Use case: background-extraction. This is a precise cleanup of the supplied colored 48-icon atlas for professional UI glyphs.
REMOVE ALL colored pixel clouds, watercolor spatters, halos, glows, speckles and traces OUTSIDE the actual dark outlined silhouettes of the icons. The current yellow spatter around round faces and red/blue spatter around hands and hearts is a defect, not artwork. Erase all of it into 100% transparent empty alpha. Especially remove all yellow scraps above/below/beside each face disc. The gold circle must end exactly at its clean navy contour with only a narrow smooth antialiased edge. Red hearts must end exactly at their dark contour. Hands/cuffs must end at their outlines. Nothing remains floating outside their normal shapes.
Use crisp clean sticker cutout edges as if each icon had been carefully isolated with a pen tool. No blurry color fringe. NO artistic spatter, NO watercolor haze outside outlines, NO drop shadow, NO glow, NO colored border beyond the original dark contour, NO transparent-looking checkerboard painted into pixels.
Preserve all 48 icons in exactly their same 8 columns by 6 rows positions and the same cell centers and grid scale. Keep their already vivid internal colors, precise facial expressions, object identities and watercolor shading INSIDE the shapes. Keep true object features including steam lines, fireworks rays, sun rays, waving motion lines, party confetti in the party popper cell and bunting string. All accidental color speckles elsewhere must vanish. No adding, rearranging, deleting, recoloring, redrawing or duplicating any actual icon. Transparent alpha backdrop only.
